## Key Projects

GitHub: https://github.com/Mahfuzul-Alam/test-run-reliability-dashboard | Live: https://mahfuzul-alam.github.io/test-run-reliability-dashboard/

## Academic Research

  - Authors: Faiaz Ben Reza, Mahfuzul Alam, Tarif Sadman, Yasmin Sultana.

  - Platforms Investigated: OutSystems, Zoho Creator, Microsoft PowerApps, Salesforce.
  - Practical Benchmark: Built a Contact Management System across all 4 platforms without custom hand-written code to evaluate development convenience, toolchain consolidation, dynamic vs static security analysis, and runtime models.
